subtitles.anime_multiverse.kakashi.kakas: Maa, maa. I came to read in peace, but it seems you are not going to allow that.
Sorry I am late. I got lost on the road of life.
You walk in like you own the road. Fine. Let me see what you carry.
My eye is open. Do not make me use all of it.
Good. That was a real strike. Now let us make this a crowd.
Pakkun, everyone. Get out here, we have company.
I borrowed this eye from a friend. He would want me to use it well.
Space bends where I look. Try to stand on the right side of it.
So this is what the last of it feels like. Then I will not hold back.
Come out. Show them what a promise looks like when it has a sword.
Raikiri.
Hold still. This will only take one breath.
Oh. You moved. That is annoying.
Not bad. Do it again and I will be impressed.
Little things first. They add up.
Watch the tags, not the knives.
I saw that. Thank you, I will keep it.
Mine now. Here, have it back.
Lightning Beast. Run it down.
It follows. Find a wall.
Water Dragon.
You are wet now. That matters, you will see why.
Hunting Fang. Bring them to the ground.
The pack never loses a scent.
One of me is bad enough. Three is rude, I know.
Surround them.
Fog. A very old trick, and still a good one.
Breathe slowly. You cannot see me, but I can see you.
Earth Style. Nothing flies through this.
Behind you.
The door is on the other side. Mind the draft.
Kamui. Raikiri.
You will not feel where it comes from.
Kamui Shuriken.
Four doors. Stand in none of them.
Everything goes in. Hold on to something.
Space turns. Let it take you, or fight it.
Too slow.
Nothing there. You hit the air between worlds.
A log. Sorry, it was the closest thing to me.
Ha. You hit the firewood.
Susanoo.
Stand behind me. All of you who have not run yet.
It cracked. Good. I was getting tired of hiding behind it.
Fair enough. That was a strong hit.
Purple Lightning. This is the last of what I have.
Do not let it find your feet.
Heh. That one stung.
Good. Better than I expected.
Careful. I am still standing.
Those who abandon their comrades are worse than scum. Remember that.
My chakra is nearly gone. So is the time you have to finish this.
One more exchange. Make it count.
That is how it ends when you are careless. I am sorry.
Do not follow them. Back up, breathe, begin again.
It is over. Next time, bring more than strength.
Remember this. Strength alone never protected anyone.
Take your time. I was late once, I know the feeling.
Maa, are you done catching your breath?
Your friends are watching your back. Do not waste that.
Well. I read the whole book and you wrote the last page. Good ending.
You are strong. Look after each other, that is where it comes from.
Lightning Cutter.
Throw lightning at me and I will cut it in two.
Lightning cut in two. I did say so.
A bolt is only a very fast line. I cut lines.
Lightning Release, Shadow Clone. Careful, it bites.
Do not touch that one.
That is the lightning. It stops the legs, not the mind.
I did warn you about the clone.
Purple Electricity.
Close range is where it hits hardest.
Purple Electricity, all around me.
Stay back, or stay down.
Wet ground carries it. Everyone connected, everyone shocked.
Purple Electricity, through the water.
Kamui. I only need to look at you.
Into the other space. You will come out somewhere else.
Earth Release, Tracking Fang.
My dogs know your scent. Hold him.
Gate of Opening, Healing, Life. That is as far as I dare.
Eight Gates. A little of it, only a little.
Kubikiribocho. A heavy one, so stand clear.
Not my sword, but it works for me.
White Light Chakra Sabre.
My father's way of fighting. Quick and quiet.
A wire. Simple, and you walked right into it.
Come here.
A kunai. Mark it and be gone.
A marker, a flash, and I am wherever I left one.
Fire Release, Great Fireball.
I have seen this done. It is easier with an eye that copies.
Obito. Lend me the rest. Both eyes, and a little more.
This is not mine to keep. I will use it once.
That is all of it. It leaves as quickly as it came.
Out of borrowed chakra. Hit me while you can.
My eye. It is bleeding. Give me a moment.
The Sharingan never rests, and I never rest with it.
You lean on that one move. So I prepared for it.
I watched you. That no longer works on me.
Observe first, attack second. An old habit.
